verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app with no account, no server and no hosted data. A sandbox-versus-production environment is not a fair axis for this kind of product. The `--synthetic` host flag streams a test pattern for developer runs, but it is a test signal, not a sandbox environment that isolates production data, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
